tagline: AI-Powered Early Mastitis Risk Forecasting System for Dairy Cattle
purpose: Gau Rakshak is an IoT and Edge-AI solution designed to forecast subclinical mastitis risk in dairy cows before physical symptoms appear, empowering dairy farmers with early alerts.
offline_capability: Gau Rakshak operates 100% offline directly on a Raspberry Pi 4 without needing internet, Wi-Fi, or cloud APIs.

hardware_components.raspberry_pi_4: Raspberry Pi 4 serves as the main offline edge computing hub running AI risk forecasting models, local database, and voice interface.
hardware_components.thermal_camera: Thermal camera captures non-invasive thermal images of the udder to detect localized temperature variations and hotspots.
hardware_components.as7343: AS7343 is a 14-channel spectral sensor used for multi-spectral optical reflection analysis of milk samples. NOTE: It is part of the multi-sensor pipeline and is NOT a standalone mastitis diagnostic device.
hardware_components.dht11: DHT11 measures ambient environmental temperature and relative humidity inside the cattle shed. NOTE: DHT11 measures shed environment, NOT internal milk temperature.
hardware_components.rfid: RFID reader scans cattle ear tags for automated individual cow identification and historical health tracking.
hardware_components.esp32: ESP32 acts as an auxiliary wireless microcontroller node for gathering sensor readings across cattle stalls.
hardware_components.solar_power: Solar panel and battery backup system ensure continuous off-grid operation in rural dairy farms.
hardware_components.oled_display: OLED screen displays real-time status, cow IDs, and system state directly on the device.

workflow: Cattle RFID Scan -> Ambient (DHT11) & Udder Thermal Imaging + Spectral Sensing (AS7343) -> RPi 4 Edge AI Inference -> Risk Score Generation -> Farmer Audio & Visual Alert.
